interventions.detail: pyproject [tool.uv] override-dependencies disables torch/triton, so `uv pip install -e .` silently skips torch; installed torch/triton with `uv pip install --no-config` from outside the repo
Installed CPU-only torch==2.15.0+cpu from the download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu index
Installed triton==3.9.0 because megatron.core imports triton unconditionally (moe/ops/paged_stash.py), even on CPU
Installed transformers==5.23.0 (only in the 'training' extra) for HuggingFaceTokenizer
Downloaded the GPT-2 tokenizer files from huggingface.co/openai-community/gpt2 into /work/gpt2
